article.title: loveholidays委託Nest製作AI社交廣告，以投放表現回饋下一批創意
article.title_en: loveholidays appoints Nest for AI creative with performance feeding the next ad batch
article.summary: loveholidays委託Nest Commerce提供創意策略及AI廣告製作，計劃每月產出200則付費社交素材。
article.summary_en: loveholidays appointed Nest Commerce for creative strategy and AI production, with a remit for 200 paid-social ads a month.
highlights: 製作範圍涵蓋英國、愛爾蘭及德國，並非已交付200則的成效報告。
已投放廣告的表現用於下一批製作，專家逐則做品牌審核。
highlights_en: The remit covers the UK, Ireland and Germany; it is not a report of 200 completed ads.
Live-ad performance informs subsequent production, with expert brand review of each ad.
article.why: 旅遊素材製作加入投放回饋後，團隊可把預訂動機拆成可比較的版本，決定下一批應保留哪種訴求。
article.why_en: Performance feedback lets travel teams compare booking motivations and decide which appeals to retain in the next batch.
article.next_step: 以同一行程分別測試選擇、方便、支援及期待四種預訂動機，固定主要投放條件，再把結果轉成下一批創意簡報。
article.next_step_en: Test choice, ease, support and anticipation for one trip under comparable delivery conditions, then use results in the next brief.
article.detail: 消息來自Nest Commerce公告轉載。簡報圍繞選擇、方便、支援及期待等旅遊動機，提供的是素材生成與回饋機制，未公布此委託的轉換或收入結果。編輯建議把每個版本對應的預訂理由寫入素材清單，讓下一輪修訂可以追溯至具體觀察；AI產量與人手品牌審核都不能代替對銷售成效的獨立判斷。
article.detail_en: This is a reproduced Nest Commerce announcement. The brief uses choice, ease, support and anticipation as travel motivations; it reports no conversion or revenue results for the remit. Tag each variant by booking reason so revisions can be traced to observations. Production volume and brand review do not establish sales effectiveness.
